_doc: Reviewed authorship decisions applied by attribution_pass.py rule C (author field only). Each 'set_author' entry names an id range, the author it expects to find (guard: the build fails if the corpus moved), the evidence, and an independent cross-check. 'flag' entries change nothing: they record contested attributions for the scholar (gate G3). review: pending until a scholar signs validation/attribution-review/.
cross_check: ShabadOS database 4.8.7, sha256 d8e071347bd5485cc6aa2533c1f51347a16ed1724b4d8abaa4939520257074c2 (Algorythmos-AI/sggs-source release shabados-database-4.8.7) -- evidence only, never a source of corpus data

decisions.author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji (M1)
decisions.evidence: Mool Mantar and Japji (section ਜਪੁ, Angs 1-8). The print carries no ਮਹਲਾ label for Japji, so the header pass left author null; Guru Nanak's authorship of Japji is universal in the tradition.

decisions.author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji
decisions.evidence: Opens with a bare ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ heading after Beni's shabad; closing couplet ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਮ ਦਲ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਕੋਊ (id 3752). The shabad closes with a single ॥੩॥, so rule A never sees it as a counted shabad.

decisions.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
decisions.evidence: Heading ਪਉੜੀ ੫ (id 14375) in Gauri ki Vaar M4: the print marks this pauri as the Fifth Guru's. The Vaar-author rule assigned it to the Vaar's author.

decisions.author: Bhagat Kabir Ji
decisions.evidence: A salok under a bare ਸਲੋਕੁ heading (no ਮਹਲਾ/ਮਃ) inside Gujri ki Vaar M3, opening ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੰਕੁੜਾ -- Kabir's salok quoted in the Vaar. The Guru's own saloks there carry ਮਃ ੩.

decisions.author: Bhagat Kabir Ji
decisions.evidence: Bare ਸਲੋਕ heading, salok ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ (Ang 555).

decisions.author: Bhagat Kabir Ji
decisions.evidence: Bare ਸਲੋਕੁ heading, salok ਕਬੀਰ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ (Ang 947).

decisions.author: Bhagat Kabir Ji
decisions.evidence: Bare ਸਲੋਕੁ heading, salok ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ (Ang 948).

decisions.author: Baba Sundar Ji
decisions.evidence: Title ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਸਦੁ names no author; closing line ਕਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ (id 39580, ॥੬॥੧॥). The header pass carried M3 forward from the preceding Anand Sahib.

decisions.author: Bhagat Parmanand Ji
decisions.evidence: Heading ਸਾਰੰਗ + ੴ, shabad ਤੈ ਨਰ ਕਿਆ ਪੁਰਾਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ closing ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨ ਚਾਲੀ (id 53934). ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ is also an ordinary word, so rule A never treats it as a signature -- hence a ledger decision.

decisions.author: Bhagat Surdas Ji
decisions.evidence: The single tuk ਛਾਡਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਮੁਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ preceding ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ. It carries no signature; the tradition credits this one line to Bhagat Surdas.

flags.note: Headings read ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ (Ang 553). Many read the ੧ as Guru Nanak, addressing Mardana; ShabadOS credits Guru Nanak Dev Ji. Left unchanged for the scholar.

Raagmala's authorship is debated; the M5 label is carried forward from Mundavani's ਮਹਲਾ ੫, and ShabadOS credits Poet Alam. Neither is settled -- left unchanged; the scholar decides whether it needs its own label.
Heading ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ (Ang 326). The print's ਮਹਲਾ ੫ is kept; ShabadOS credits Kabir.
Heading ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫, closing ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਖਾਨਾ (Ang 1136). The print's ਮਹਲਾ ੫ is kept; ShabadOS credits Kabir.
Heading ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ (Ang 1253). The print's ਮਹਲਾ ੫ is kept; ShabadOS credits Surdas.

ShabadOS splits some Swaiyye differently (The Bhatts->Gayand 42 lines, Kalsahar->Jalap 6, Sal->Bhikha 6, Mathura->Haribans 5). bhatt_attribution.json is a prior SME-audited table and is not changed here.
